sections.title: NIH/BI Fellowship
sections.description: Students will do full time research during June, July, and August, and attend weekly seminars. They will find a research mentor at Penn, write a proposal that is evaluated by a selction committee to pick who is in the program, do full time research during the summer, attend weekly seminars run by the program, present their work as a poster at a national meeting, do a powerpoint presentation, write up their research in the form of a scientific manuscript, and submit their work to the Phi Zeta Student Research Day.
